connector.modeled: Owner decision 2026-11-05: no SMA/coax; 50 ohm vertical AddLumpedPort at the line start (board edge y=-13), strip width, R=50 ohm; S11 reference plane = line start, no de-embedding (run with --edge-port lumped). Feed: 50 ohm line (w 3.92 mm, y -13 -> -9.751) + lambda/4 transformer (w 0.80 mm, l 6.60 mm) touching the radiating edge y=-3.151 (no inset, no notch).

feed.line_width_method: Hammerstad-Jensen (with Wheeler 35 um thickness correction) on eps_r 4.4, h 2.07 mm: w = 3.919 mm -> 3.92 mm gives Z0 = 49.99 ohm, eps_eff = 3.308 (estimate, GEOMETRY_ONLY)
feed.transformer_width_method: Hammerstad-Jensen static Z0 (Wheeler 35 um correction): w 0.80 mm -> Zt 102.5 ohm; Kirschning-Jansen eps_eff(f0) 3.197 (GUIDE_MODEL)

parasitic_params.note: Only Wp changes with respect to US3_PS4 (11.0 -> 9.0 mm); Wp sweep 11 (036) / 10 / 9 / 8 / 7 (040) requested by the owner on 2026-11-16.

US3_PS4.note: single change; everything else as US3_PS4 (and as US3_PS4_1 except Wp). Mesh hint y -2.99 as US3_PS4_1.

rationale: Intermediate point of a Wp sweep between US3_PS4 (Wp 11 mm, 036: S11 minima 7.826 / 8.158 GHz, worst -10.66 dB, eta valley 0.244 at 8.137 GHz) and US3_PS4_1 (Wp 7 mm, 040: single minimum 7.972 GHz, worst -7.71 dB, shallow eta valley 0.517 at 7.887 GHz). The cause of the 040 behaviour is NOT identified (stronger coupling reduction, parasitic self-frequency change or mode crossing, validator 2026-11-16); this sweep is the discriminating experiment. No interpolation between 036 and 040 is assumed: the validator noted that two points give no basis for a monotonic response. GEOMETRY_ONLY; no S11, efficiency or gain is claimed.

pre_registered_hypothesis.H0_sweep: Across Wp 11 -> 10 -> 9 -> 8 -> 7 the separation between the two S11 minima shrinks monotonically and the lower minimum rises monotonically, until they merge somewhere between 8 and 7 mm. H0 is false if any intermediate point breaks the monotonic order (e.g. a single minimum at 9 or 10 mm followed by two minima at 8 mm) or if the merge already happens at 10 mm.
pre_registered_hypothesis.H1: Worst S11 in the channel (1 MHz grid, 501 samples) <= -10 dB for at least one of the three widths, with the lower minimum above 7.826 GHz. Not claimed.
pre_registered_hypothesis.H2: eta >= 0.55 and realized broadside gain >= 2 dBi at the 11 NF2FF points. Expected to FAIL for the widths that keep two minima (the eta valley of 036 is tied to the upper mode); expected to pass or nearly pass for a merged/single-minimum response like 040.
pre_registered_hypothesis.decision_rule: If one width meets H1 with a smaller eta valley than 036, report it as the candidate refinement of US3_PS4 (fine mesh and HFSS are owner decisions). If none meets H1, report the sweep as a map and keep US3_PS4 / US3_PS6 as references. If H0 is false, report the non-monotonic behaviour and do not extrapolate further.

manufacturability.layers: 3 copper layers (L1 patch + feed + U-slot at z=h, L2 floating parasitic at z=1.035 mm, L3 ground at z=0) and 2 dielectric layers of ~1.035 mm each: standard 3-copper-layer FR4 multilayer. Stack-up unchanged by this variant (z_par and h1/h2 NOT modified).
manufacturability.vias: none: floating parasitic, planar microstrip feed.
manufacturability.min_feature_mm: U-slot arms 0.8 mm (unchanged); the parasitic is a solid rectangle 9.0 x 7.46 mm, no feature < 0.8 mm. The narrower sheet leaves more FR4 prepreg/core copper-free around it on the inner layer (inner-layer copper density lower: ask the fabricator whether a dummy-fill/balancing rule is applied; any fill must stay outside a margin of several mm of the sheet and the patch).
manufacturability.stackup_note: As US3_PS4: the model assumes ONE homogeneous eps_r 4.4 over 2.07 mm; the fabricator must give the real stack-up. z_par is not changed, so no new dependency on the stack-up is introduced.
manufacturability.tolerances_to_specify: inner-layer etching of Wp (+-0.05 mm of 9.0 mm is 0.56 %; effect on k small compared with Lp) and layer-to-layer registration in x and y (a +-0.1 mm offset of the sheet is much smaller than the 1.211 mm clearance to the patch x edge and the 0.171 mm y clearance to the transformer end is a plan-view distance on different layers). Lp etching sensitivity of ~10 MHz per 0.01 mm of PS4 is unchanged.
manufacturability.risks: The k(Wp) law is a guide and may under- or over-predict; the sheet is buried and cannot be inspected or tuned after lamination; homogeneous FR4 model is provisional; the dark upper mode is poorly radiating and dissipates in the FR4, so the improvement in S11, if any, is by loss.

purpose: Map the S11 / eta behaviour of US3_PS4 versus the buried-parasitic width Wp (point Wp = 9.0 mm), in openEMS base mesh with the 036/040 command.
mesh_hint_note: Hints y [-0.215, -2.99] as US3_PS4_1 (prepare-checked for base and fine meshes per variant before solving).
